summary_te: व्यवसायी ने ग्राहक को फोन किया और उन्हें 499 रुपये का हेयर ऑयल दिखाया। ग्राहक ने शिपिंग शुल्क के बारे में पूछा, जिसका एजेंट के पास कोई जवाब नहीं था। ग्राहक ने कहा कि वह बाद में सोचकर बताएगी, लेकिन बाद में उसने दोबारा कॉल न करने और अपना नंबर हटाने का अनुरोध किया। एजेंट ने इस अनुरोध को स्वीकार किया और कॉल समाप्त कर दी।
summary_en: The business agent called the customer to present a hair oil product priced at 499 rupees. The customer inquired about shipping charges, but the agent stated that this information was not currently available. Although the customer initially mentioned that she would think about it, she ultimately requested to be removed from the calling list to stop receiving such calls. The agent agreed to the request and concluded the call.
next_action: Do not contact this number. The caller opted out.
objections: The customer did not want to receive further calls on this number.
unanswered_questions: Does this hair oil incur any shipping charges?
